success_metrics: Technical path status is resolved for nominal and stress lifecycles.
Nominal and stress net PnL are positive with profit factor above 1.0.
Stress net PnL and profit factor remain positive after removing the largest winner.
Long and short stress net PnL remain positive after removing each side's largest winner.
At least two of three chronological development folds are stress-positive.
failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any source hash, exact audit bound, funding identity, or generator dependency changes during evaluation.
Any validation or holdout economics are evaluated or used for selection.
Stress net, stress ex-largest-winner net, either side's stress ex-largest-winner net, or majority-fold stability is nonpositive.
confidence_level: High confidence that this isolates continuation versus reversion under the same development contract; low confidence that the economic hypothesis will pass until the immutable replay completes.
claim_falsifiers: A code or artifact audit showing parameters, friction, source window, or risk semantics differ from the reversion baseline would falsify the isolation claim.
A technically resolved stress-negative or outlier-dependent result would reject the continuation hypothesis.
A source mutation or OOS access would invalidate this experiment rather than support either mechanism.
single_highest_value_next_investigation: Run and independently verify this one frozen development-only continuation replay, then retain no-action unless it clears every preregistered criterion.
